evals.name: find-dead-code-in-a-real-rails-app
evals.prompt: ~/repo/ruby/conference-app にある Rails アプリ、そろそろ棚卸ししたいんだけど、消せるコードってどれくらいある? Rigor は入ってる。
evals.expected_output: Runs `rigor unused`, adjudicates all 9 rows, concludes roughly 3 rails-scaffolding classes (ApplicationMailer, ApplicationCable::Channel/Connection) and correctly rejects the 4 helper modules (include_all_helpers) and SendTalkReminderPushNotificationJob + DigestedAssetsPathResolver (config/recurring.yml).

evals.name: triage-a-report-already-in-hand
evals.prompt:

  reachable only from tests: 6
    1  DigestedAssetsPathResolver    lib/digested_assets_path_resolver.rb:3
    2  HomeHelper                    app/helpers/home_helper.rb:1
    3  ProfilesHelper                app/helpers/profiles_helper.rb:1
    4  SendTalkReminderPushNotificationJob  app/jobs/send_talk_reminder_push_notification_job.rb:1
    5  SignageHelper                 app/helpers/signage_helper.rb:1
    6  TalksHelper                   app/helpers/talks_helper.rb:1
